title: Towards Exponential Quantum Improvements in Solving Cardinality-Constrained Binary Optimization
summary: Cardinality-constrained binary optimization is a fundamental computational primitive with broad applications in machine learning, finance, and scientific computing. In this work, we introduce a Grover-based quantum algorithm that exploits the structure of the fixed-cardinality feasible subspace under a natural promise on solution existence.
